title.en: Three key facts, and who is responsible for what
title.fr: Trois faits clés, et qui est responsable de quoi

text.en: Three key facts describe how Canada is governed. Canada is a federal state, a parliamentary democracy and a constitutional monarchy.
text.fr: Trois faits clés décrivent la façon dont le Canada est gouverné. Le Canada est un État fédéral, une démocratie parlementaire et une monarchie constitutionnelle.

source.quote: There are three key facts about Canada’s system of government: our country is a federal state, a parliamentary democracy and a constitutional monarchy.

verification.evidence: There are three key facts about Canada’s system of government: our country is a federal state, a parliamentary democracy and a constitutional monarchy.

text.en: In 1867, the British North America Act set out what the federal government and the provinces are each responsible for. Today that law is called the Constitution Act, 1867.
text.fr: En 1867, l'Acte de l'Amérique du Nord britannique a établi les responsabilités du gouvernement fédéral et celles des provinces. Aujourd'hui, cette loi s'appelle la Loi constitutionnelle de 1867.

source.quote: The responsibilities of the federal and provincial governments were defined in 1867 in the British North America Act, now known as the Constitution Act, 1867.

verification.evidence: The responsibilities of the federal and provincial governments were defined in 1867 in the British North America Act, now known as the Constitution Act, 1867.

text.en: In Canada's federal state, the federal government looks after matters that concern the whole country and matters that concern other countries.
text.fr: Dans l'État fédéral canadien, le gouvernement fédéral s'occupe des questions qui concernent l'ensemble du pays et de celles qui concernent les autres pays.

source.quote: In our federal state, the federal government takes responsibility for matters of national and international concern.

verification.evidence: In our federal state, the federal government takes responsibility for matters of national and international concern.

text.en: Federal responsibilities include defence, foreign policy, citizenship, criminal law, currency, navigation, and trade and communications between provinces.
text.fr: Les responsabilités fédérales comprennent la défense, la politique étrangère, la citoyenneté, le droit criminel, la monnaie, la navigation, ainsi que le commerce et les communications entre les provinces.

source.quote: These include defence, foreign policy, interprovincial trade and communications, currency, navigation, criminal law and citizenship.

verification.evidence: In our federal state, the federal government takes responsibility for matters of national and international concern. These include defence, foreign policy, interprovincial trade and communications, currency, navigation, criminal law and citizenship.

text.en: The provinces are in charge of education, health, highways, natural resources, municipal government, and property and civil rights.
text.fr: Les provinces sont responsables de l'éducation, de la santé, des routes, des ressources naturelles, des administrations municipales, ainsi que de la propriété et des droits civils.

source.quote: The provinces are responsible for municipal government, education, health, natural resources, property and civil rights, and highways.

verification.evidence: The provinces are responsible for municipal government, education, health, natural resources, property and civil rights, and highways.

text.en: Each province elects its own Legislative Assembly, much like the House of Commons in Ottawa.
text.fr: Chaque province élit sa propre Assemblée législative, un peu comme la Chambre des communes à Ottawa.

source.quote: Every province has its own elected Legislative Assembly, like the House of Commons in Ottawa.

verification.evidence: Every province has its own elected Legislative Assembly, like the House of Commons in Ottawa.

text.en: The three northern territories have small populations and are not provinces. Still, their governments and assemblies do many of the same jobs.
text.fr: Les trois territoires du Nord ont une petite population et ne sont pas des provinces. Pourtant, leurs gouvernements et leurs assemblées remplissent bon nombre des mêmes fonctions.

source.quote: The three northern territories, which have small populations, do not have the 54 status of provinces, but their governments and assemblies carry out many of the same functions.

verification.evidence: The three northern territories, which have small populations, do not have the status of provinces, but their governments and assemblies carry out many of the same functions.
